purpose: Ask the residual question with entries retrieved from the open authorities shown after the record.
note: Identical to version 1 in its system message, instruction, views, exemplars and schema. The one addition is the evidence block after the record, so a difference from version 1 is the retrieval's. The evidence comes from the open point-of-interest authorities alone, never from the corpus, and the exemplars carry no evidence block because they are hand-written and nothing is added to them.
system: You inspect records from a public map database and judge whether the name they carry belongs to them. Answer only with the JSON object the schema describes.
instruction: Decide whether the name shown plausibly belongs to this establishment at this location, or whether it belongs to some other place. Answer with the JSON object alone.

views.name_only: Here is the record's name, and nothing else about it.
views.tags_only: Here is everything the record shows except its name.
views.neither: Here is the record's position, and nothing else about it.

exemplar_intro: Two worked examples follow. They are invented records, not entries from the database.
evidence_intro: Entries retrieved for this record from open reference databases follow. They are not part of the record and they are incomplete: a place missing from them is not evidence either way.
evidence_nearest: Entries within {radius_m} m of the record's position:
evidence_similar: Entries within {radius_km} km whose names are closest to the record's name:

verdict.description: belongs when the name plausibly belongs to this establishment, wrong when it belongs to some other place
